findings.note: Dowdle is questionable for the Paris game with a new knee injury, separate from the toe issue that kept him out earlier. He was limited all week, and his status was expected with inactives 90 minutes before the 9:30 a.m. ET kickoff.

Dowdle was clearly the RB2 in his Week 6 return: Warren played 74% of snaps and had 14 carries to Dowdle's 7, though both got four targets. Covers picks Dowdle for an anytime TD (not receptions) and cites 16 mph winds in Paris.

ESPN's game log shows 3 catches for 9 yards in the Week 6 return at TB, and 7 catches across three games this season. Its fantasy note says he seems more likely than not to play, but expects him to share work with Warren.
